init.title: Optionen
init.description: Rated battery parameters are optional specifications. Location is enabled for new accounts and can be disabled. Controls require explicit opt-in and a vehicle allowlist; cloud acceptance does not confirm completion.

data_description.enable_coordinates: Showing location uses the existing status query and may save location history in Home Assistant. Disable it to stop exposing coordinates. The coordinate reference is unverified.

model_parameters.title: Batterienennwerte konfigurieren
model_parameters.description: Enter rated voltage and capacity. Changes update the same entity; these are not measured capacity or battery health.

abort.model_unavailable: Load the integration and choose a current vehicle before configuring rated parameters.

error.model_unavailable: Choose a current vehicle belonging to this integration account.
error.model_storage_invalid: Battery parameter storage is unavailable. Resolve the Repair before saving.

controls_disabled.message: Command not sent: enable controls, allow this vehicle, and check authentication, fresh data and known denials. Vehicle control status explains the current blocker.

control_uncertain.message: Control outcome is unconfirmed; it may have executed. Check the vehicle before retrying.

control_readback_failed.message: The command was accepted, but current status could not be read. Physical completion is unconfirmed.

busy.message: The request queue is full; try again later.

model_storage_invalid.message: Battery parameter storage is unavailable. Resolve the Repair before saving.

invalid_auth.message: The session is invalid; reauthenticate through Devices & services.

query_unavailable.message: Vehicle query unavailable: ensure the integration is loaded, the session is valid and the vehicle remains in a fresh account vehicle list.

query_device.message: Select one unambiguous Ninebot vehicle device belonging to this integration.

query_coordinates.message: Enable coordinates in integration options before requesting a trip track.

query_detail_limit.message: When including details, set the page size to five or less.

query_ride.message: The ride does not have one verified detail mapping in this vehicle and month. Specify the correct month and use Get trips first.

history_range.message: Choose an ordered month range of at most 360 months.

history_cursor.message: The continuation expired, was evicted, or belongs to another vehicle/range. Start again.

statistics_range.message: Select a range of one to six months with the start no later than the end.

statistics_unavailable.message: Statistics storage is unavailable. Resolve its Repair; vehicle telemetry can continue.

statistics_recorder.message: Recorder must be running to import native statistics. Period query Actions still work without it.

statistics_timezone.message: Native period charts currently require the Home Assistant time zone Asia/Shanghai. Query responses remain available in other time zones.

statistics_import_data.message: Existing statistics have incompatible units, shape or period values, or exceed the import budget. Nothing in this batch was queued. Review the statistics before retrying.

entity_identity_conflict.title: Duplicate legacy entity identities
entity_identity_conflict.description: Multiple legacy entities represent the same function. Their identities and history are preserved; equivalent sensors continue to receive values. No entries were deleted. Review automations and user settings before deciding which entities to retain through the HA UI.

migration_identity_invalid.title: Legacy account identity is invalid
migration_identity_invalid.description: Migration stopped because the legacy business identity is invalid. Existing configuration and sessions were preserved. Check the backup and confirm the account identity before retrying; do not merge accounts by vehicle nickname.

legacy_device_unmatched.title: Legacy device identity is unmatched
legacy_device_unmatched.description: An existing device identity is absent from the current account vehicle list. The vehicle may have been removed or use a different interface identity. Entities and history are preserved; no nickname-based merge was attempted. Check the backup and current identities before making changes through the HA UI.

session_recovery_pending.title: Session recovery needs a restart
session_recovery_pending.description: After a failed session update, HA could not unload the runtime using the replacement session. Its files were not replaced; the transaction journal and previous session backup remain. Back up HA configuration and restart HA to recover the previous session at startup. If recovery fails, retain the backup and check storage permissions; do not manually delete session directories.

model_storage_invalid.title: Battery parameter storage unavailable
model_storage_invalid.description: Cloud telemetry continues, but the optional battery parameter file is invalid or uses an unsupported version. The file has not been overwritten. Restore a compatible backup before changing parameters.

ride_event_storage_invalid.title: Ride event storage unavailable
ride_event_storage_invalid.description: The event cursor store is unreadable, incompatible or cannot be safely written. Event emission is suspended. Retain configuration/storage backups and check storage permissions and the integration version. Do not edit or delete the cursor file as a repair attempt. Other vehicle state and queries remain available.

travel_statistics_storage.title: Travel statistics storage unavailable
travel_statistics_storage.description: The private history statistics file is invalid or uses an unsupported version. It has not been overwritten. Current vehicle telemetry continues. Keep configuration backups and check storage permissions and the integration version before restoring a compatible backup.

get_trips.name: Fahrten abrufen
get_trips.description: Query a vehicle month with local pagination. Cloud completeness is unknown. Detail requests require a limit of five or less.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Select the vehicle device, not a battery component.

month.name: Month
month.description: Business month YYYYMM, for example 202609. Future months are rejected.

page.name: Page
page.description: Page within the rows returned by ninecli, not cloud pagination.

limit.name: Page size
limit.description: Maximum 100; maximum five when including details.

include_detail.name: Include details
include_detail.description: Read at most five trip details in this call.

include_track.name: Include track
include_track.description: Requires details and coordinates opt-in. Precise locations may persist in automation traces or response variables.

get_trip_detail.name: Fahrtdetails abrufen
get_trip_detail.description: Query one trip verified in the selected vehicle and month. No history scan or vehicle control.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Select the vehicle device, not a battery component.

ride_id.name: Ride ID
ride_id.description: Use the ride_id returned by Get trips for this vehicle and month.

query_month.name: Query month
query_month.description: YYYYMM; defaults to the current month in Asia/Shanghai. Specify it for older trips.

max_points.name: Point limit
max_points.description: Maximum 2000; defaults to 500. Also bounds speed samples.

include_track.name: Include track
include_track.description: Requires coordinates opt-in. Precise locations may persist in automation traces or response variables.

get_history.name: Fahrtenhistorie abrufen
get_history.description: Explicit batches of 3 months (max 6). Continuations last 15 minutes. Missing ride pages stay incomplete. Returns history, charts and scoped statistics; indexing is memory-only, without automatic archiving or Recorder import.

get_statistics.name: Zeitraumstatistiken abrufen
get_statistics.description: Return up to six months and their business-day statistics. Reads stored data by default; refresh uses the existing query cache. Missing data is not zero or proof of full history.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Vehicle device belonging to a loaded account.

start_month.name: Start month
start_month.description: YYYYMM; at most six months per response.

end_month.name: End month
end_month.description: YYYYMM, no later than the current business month.

include_daily.name: Include daily statistics
include_daily.description: Keep missing days null; never distribute monthly energy across days.

refresh.name: Query upstream months
refresh.description: Explicitly query the selected months, reusing fresh cache; never fetch tracks.

import_statistics.name: Verlaufsstatistiken importieren
import_statistics.description: Explicitly write valid closed day/month periods from the ledger to Recorder. Up to six months; no cloud request, hourly distribution or missing-data padding.

device_id.name: Vehicle
device_id.description: Vehicle device belonging to a loaded account.

start_month.name: Start month
start_month.description: YYYYMM; at most six months per response.

end_month.name: End month
end_month.description: YYYYMM, no later than the current business month.

include_daily.name: Include daily statistics
include_daily.description: Also import verified daily statistics; disable to import closed months only.
